title_en: Physics-informed neural networks for solving forward and inverse flow problems via the Boltzmann-BGK formulation
title_zh: 通过Boltzmann–BGK表述求解正逆流动问题的物理信息神经网络

verified_metadata.title: Physics-informed neural networks for solving forward and inverse flow problems via the Boltzmann-BGK formulation
verified_metadata.abstract: PINN-BGK learns equilibrium and non-equilibrium distributions while enforcing discrete-velocity BGK equations across continuum and rarefied regimes.
verified_metadata.comment: JCP article cross-checked with arXiv manuscript

sections.title: 作者信息
paragraphs: 作者 Qin Lou、Xuhui Meng、George Em Karniadakis；Journal of Computational Physics 447, 110676 (2021)，DOI:10.1016/j.jcp.2021.110676。核验 arXiv:2010.09147 全文30页。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: Navier–Stokes只适用于continuum limit，而micro/nano flows可进入rarefied regime。能否用统一physics-informed network求解跨Knudsen数的Boltzmann–BGK正问题，并在边界条件未知时仅凭少量内部velocity sensors重建全流场？

sections.title: 背景
paragraphs: BGK kinetic equation让distribution f向local Maxwellian/equilibrium f_eq以relaxation time τ松弛，宏观density、momentum和energy由velocity moments得到。离散velocity后，每个f_i满足transport-relaxation PDE。
PINN不需要空间mesh，但仍需选collocation points、discrete velocities和network capacity；自动微分替代导数离散不代表没有velocity-space或optimization误差。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: PINN-BGK由三个部分组成：NN_eq近似equilibrium distribution，NN_neq近似non-equilibrium correction，physics part通过automatic differentiation计算BGK residual，并加入initial/boundary/data mismatch。不同subdomains可各用网络并在interface约束连续。
正问题覆盖Kovasznay、Taylor–Green、lid-driven cavity、micro-Couette；逆问题不给wall boundary condition，只在内部稀疏位置提供u observations。训练采用Adam与L-BFGS-B，并测试跨参数transfer learning。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
paragraphs: Figure 1明确三网络架构、discrete velocities及physics residual。Tables 1–3和Figures 2–4显示continuum benchmarks与解析或LBM参考总体一致；accuracy依赖network width和domain decomposition。
Figures 5–8覆盖Kn=0.01–5的micro-Couette正/逆问题。Figures 9–11显示micro-cavity逆问题：random interior sensors可恢复vortex，但均匀传感线若避开边界/涡核，近壁误差明显；增加靠近关键区域的measurements后改善。
transfer-learning表格在特定2D Kovasznay设置约有三倍speedup。该数字不是通用PINN复杂度结论，也未与成熟kinetic solvers在相同精度和硬件上全面比较。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: 实验是稳态或规则benchmark，reference多为analytic/LBM/DUGKS；高维velocity space、3D unsteady rarefied flow和turbulence会显著提高collocation与训练成本。inverse accuracy对sensor placement敏感。
BGK是单松弛近似，不覆盖所有collision physics；论文未系统报告多seed优化方差、wall-clock/energy、公平mesh-solver基线或noisy sensor robustness。所谓同一代码仍需按case设置scaling、boundary loss和subdomains。

sections.title: 复现与资源
paragraphs: 全文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.09147；期刊：https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jcp.2021.110676。PDF SHA-256：5ef8daa46b84f631cfa82ad75cd5ea27a52b75f022ab589e893684d8ead657d6。正文未给公开代码仓库。

复现需固定discrete velocity set、Kn/τ、network layers、activation、collocation/boundary/sensor points、loss weights、Adam/L-BFGS-B stopping、subdomain interfaces与reference solver。Evidence status: full-text verified numerical study; no independent reproduction performed.

sections.title: 阅读指南
paragraphs: 先读 pp.1–5 BGK与Figure 1；pp.6–14看continuum正问题；pp.15–23看rarefied正逆问题和sensor placement；pp.24–25读总结；pp.26–30为参考文献。
